# Dhinovatech

> Dhinovatech makes privacy-first apps for Windows (Microsoft Store) and Android (Google Play). Most of them run entirely on the user's device, with on-device AI and no account.

## Apps

- [Smart Photos](https://www.dhinovatech.com/smart-photos/): Free AI photo organizer for Windows 10 and 11. Search photos in your own words, faces grouped, places map, Memories and duplicate clean-up, all on the PC with no setup, no account and no cloud. A private alternative to Google Photos.
- [Stow](https://www.dhinovatech.com/stow/): Offline AI photo and file organizer and duplicate finder for Windows.
- [Nudge](https://www.dhinovatech.com/nudge/): Offline journal and diary for Windows with an on-device AI companion; entries are plain Markdown files.
- [GlowCompare for Windows](https://www.dhinovatech.com/glowcompare-windows/): Skincare tracker with AI progress analysis, for Windows.
- [GlowCompare](https://www.dhinovatech.com/glowcompare/): Skincare routine and visual progress tracker for Android.
- [AES Vault](https://www.dhinovatech.com/aes-vault/): Lock files and folders on Windows with AES-256-GCM encryption, offline.
- [Notelock](https://www.dhinovatech.com/notelock/): Password-protected, encrypted notepad for Windows.
- [Mortgage Loan EMI Pro](https://www.dhinovatech.com/mortgage-loan-emi-pro/): Loan EMI, prepayment and payoff calculator for Windows.
- [Milk Monthly Expense Calendar](https://www.dhinovatech.com/milk-monthly-expense-calendar/): Milk delivery diary and bill tracker for Android, in 12+ Indian languages.
- [Slouch Guard](https://www.dhinovatech.com/slouch-guard/): Real-time posture reminder.

## Smart Photos: key facts

- What it is: a free photo organizer for Windows 10 (version 2004 or later) and Windows 11, x64 and ARM64, made by Dhinovatech and sold in the Microsoft Store (ID 9N1J0MC0V89G).
- Price: free. The free version includes every feature and 30 searches a month (only typed searches count; they refill on the 1st). Smart Photos Pro is an optional one-time in-app purchase that unlocks unlimited searches. No subscription, no ads.
- Setup: install from the Microsoft Store and pick your photo folders. No account, no server, no Docker, no database. Browsing works right away; the AI models (about 1.8 GB) download once inside the app.
- Privacy: all AI runs on the PC. Photos, faces and searches are never uploaded; no telemetry; works offline. Original files are never modified.
- Features: search in your own words, face grouping, places map, Memories, text in photos (OCR), duplicate and blurry photo clean-up, albums, Windows Hello-locked hidden photos, RAW/HEIC/AVIF/JXL and most video formats.
- Imports: Google Takeout and iCloud Photos exports with their dates, albums and favorites; Picasa, Lightroom, digiKam and Windows Photo Gallery face tags.
- Requirements: 8 GB RAM (16 GB recommended). No Copilot+ PC or graphics card needed; uses a GPU or NPU when present.
- Languages: 25, and search works in each of them.
- Compared with others: Microsoft Photos searches in your own words only on Copilot+ PCs and groups faces only in Photos Legacy; Immich and PhotoPrism need a Docker server (Docker Desktop or WSL 2 on Windows); digiKam needs a database and named examples before it recognizes faces; Google Photos stores the library in Google's cloud and needs a Google Account.
- Pages: [overview](https://www.dhinovatech.com/smart-photos/), [privacy policy](https://www.dhinovatech.com/smart-photos/privacy.html), [Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9N1J0MC0V89G)
